spans.s:
m. (-गः)
1 Speed, dispatch, velocity.
2 Impetus, momentum.
3 Stream, current.
4 Sudden impulse, transition of mind. as from passion to apathy, &c.
5 Determination, promptitude, energy, that effect of mind which is considered as the source of action.
6 Pleasure, delight.
7 Love, the sentiment or passion.
8 External indication of any internal effect, proceeding from passion, medicine, poison, &c., as convulsion, horripilation, sweat, &c.
9 Expulsion or evacuation of the [] natural excretions.
10 Semen virile.
11 The flight of an arrow.
12 The fruit of a kind of mango.
E.
वीज to go, aff. घञ्.

ind.
Quickly, speedily.
E.
वेग, and तसि aff.

m. (-नः)
Phlegm, the phlegmatic humor.
E.
वेग activity or speed, and नाशन injuring, inducing corpulency.

m. (-धः)
1 Check, remora.
2 Obstruction of the natural excretions.
E.
वेग, and रोध hindrance.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Quick, expeditious.
2 Agitated.
E.
वेग, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very quick.
f. (-री)
A species of metre, having nine syllables for the first and third pādas, and eleven for the second and fourth.
E.
वेगवत्, and तरप् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Very quick or swift.
E.
वेगवत्, and तमप् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Stopping, retarding.
2 Constipation, &c.
E.
वेग, and विघारण withholding.

m. (-रः)
A mule.
E.
वेग speed, सर who goes.

m. (-तः)
1 Stop, check.
2 Obstruction of the natural excretions.
E.
वेग, and आघात resistance.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Quickened, expedited.
E.
वीज to go, causal v., क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
Speed, quickness.
E.
तल् added to the next; also वगित्वं.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Swift, fleet, rapid.
m. (-गी)
1 A courier, an express.
2 A hawk.
E.
वेग speed, इनि aff.
